picks.what: The city toward Lake Onega, aerial photograph
picks.why: best general view: city blocks running down to Lake Onega; railway yard in the foreground trimmed

gaps: P0–P4: nothing; P5: only a single building
notes: #1 (1941, Finnish wartime archive SA-kuva) is a sharp, correctly identified photo but shows only a plain theater building on Karl Marx Avenue, so I skipped it; it could fill P5 if a single-building view is acceptable. #3 (from the lake) shows mostly trees and the Karelia Hotel; #2 is a fisheye view of a new housing district.
